summary: The single blocking finding is valid and should be repaired by including the issue's schema-repair re-prompt fallback in scope.

items.title: 1. Schema-repair re-prompt fallback is silently dropped from scope
items.rationale: Issue #352 explicitly lists schema-repair-only re-prompting when auto-fill is not possible. The draft should carry that requirement instead of narrowing the bugfix to prompt wording and passive empty-array normalization.
items.evidence: Issue #352 Proposed Improvements includes: "If auto-fill is not possible, re-prompt using a schema-repair-only prompt to get corrected output." Current draft.json decisionMap.decisionPoints and scopeVerification.in omit this fallback.
